1 | /**
2 |  * Integration slot registry.
3 |  *
4 |  * Feature modules register themselves here so they can be plugged into
5 |  * the workspace without editing the map or shell internals.
6 |  *
7 |  * This is the programmatic integration mechanism. INTEGRATION_SLOT
8 |  * comments in source files are supplemental markers only.
9 |  *
10 |  * ── How to register a feature module (see INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md) ───────────
11 |  *
12 |  *   1. Create a component that accepts SlotProps.
13 |  *   2. Call registerSlot() in your module's init file.
14 |  *   3. The corresponding workspace page will render your component.
15 |  *
16 |  * ── Contract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
17 |  *
18 |  *   - Unregistered slots render an IntegrationPlaceholder component.
19 |  *   - Registration must not throw; failures are swallowed and the
20 |  *     placeholder is shown instead.
21 |  *   - A slot must not import private files from other feature modules.
22 |  */
23 | 
24 | import type { ComponentType } from 'react'
25 | import type { SelectedEntity } from '../contexts/WorkspaceContext'
26 | 
27 | // ── Slot identifiers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28 | 
29 | export type SlotId =
30 |   | 'summaries.context-panel'
31 |   | 'dependencies.workspace'
32 |   | 'reuse.findings'
33 |   | 'duplicates.compare'
34 |   | 'unused.review'
35 |   | 'ask.workspace'
36 |   | 'proposals.detail'
37 | 
38 | // ── Slot props (the public API a feature component receives) ───────────────
39 | 
40 | export interface SlotProps {
41 |   projectId: string
42 |   snapshotId: string
43 |   snapshot: import('../types/v1').Snapshot
44 |   selectedEntity: SelectedEntity | null
45 |   files: import('../types/v1').FileRecord[]
46 | }
47 | 
48 | // ── Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
49 | 
50 | type SlotComponent = ComponentType<SlotProps>
51 | 
52 | const _registry = new Map<SlotId, SlotComponent>()
53 |
